summary: Iteration 2 covered the 4-book odds, the closing-line freeze, the season tracker, the cron auth, the SDS site chrome and regressions. Backend: 10 of 10 pytest tests pass. Frontend: every requested flow passes with no page errors.

issues: Home, Products and About are hidden below the sm breakpoint and there is no menu, so mobile users only see Sports and Contact (the logo links home). Consider adding a menu.
The unit suffix renders as an uppercase-looking 'U' in the font-num font (+33.67U). Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: add a mobile menu so Home, Products and About can be reached at 390px.

Caveat: the season tracker shows +33.67u at a +9.1% ROI at 4%+ EV, but it is graded against synthetic SAMPLE closing lines. The sample note is shown. Keep it until real odds exist, because these numbers would mislead users.
critical_code_review_comments: nfl_season recomputes build_week for every week on each call. It takes about 2.4s cold and 0.3s warm, which is fine now, but cache it per (season, trained_at) if more seasons or weeks are added.
cron_nfl_refresh reads os.environ['WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET']. If the variable is missing and a Bearer token is sent, this raises a KeyError and returns 500 instead of 401/503. Use .get() and fail closed.
The kickoff freeze is applied in both refresh_odds and the pipeline (w < week or kicked_off). This works correctly: after a pipeline re-run, refresh updated only MNF CHI@SEA (1 of 14).
The JOB state is still in memory (same as iteration 1).
seed_data_creation: None. The pipeline was re-run once via the test, and odds refresh regenerated sample odds for the one pending week-8 game.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clock is about 2026-11-03 00:10 UTC. In week 8, 13 of 14 games are final; only MNF CHI@SEA is pending, so refresh returns updated=1. Season min_ev 0.02/0.04/0.08 give 521/369/137 plays. Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest backend/tests/test_nfl_api.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. The week record now includes roi. Recharts animates, so wait about 2s before screenshotting the season chart.
